title: When Enough Is Enough
coreMove: Name the sufficiency line before more starts impersonating responsibility.
sourcePressure: Introduces sufficiency as a leadership judgment: more can keep sounding responsible after the original need is met, and pursuit can slip its purpose.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Turning the chapter into anti-ambition or simple moderation instead of judging when pursuit detaches from purpose.

counterintuition: numbers versus people as a flat binary
